immediately.

open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 4:55PM MDT until August 10 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 455 PM MDT, Peak flows have already occurred in Beaver Canyon, but
flows will remain high in the Grove area before gradually receding
over the next 1 to 2 hours. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud,
vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Cottonwood Burn Scar in
Beaver county.

SOURCE...Law enforcement reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Cottonwood Burn Scar in Beaver County.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
The Cottonwood Burn Scar in Beaver county, Beaver Canyon downstream
into the Grove area.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Cottonwood Burn Scar in Beaver County. Severe debris flows can
also be anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed
away in places. If you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING FOR THE COTTONWOOD BURN SCAR REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 PM MDT THIS EVENING FOR EAST CENTRAL BEAVER COUNTY
